integrity: The sharp theorem is supported by the included complete analytic proof; finite exact-rational computations are corroboration, not an infinite proof. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
limitations: Finite connected simple cactus metric graphs with positive lengths, unweighted arclength, real mean-zero edgewise H1. Not weighted graphs, graphs with overlapping cycles, higher derivatives, or higher Lp norms. Bibliographic completeness is not independently certified.
title: Exact mean-zero Sobolev evaluation and the finite quadratic envelope of metric cactus graphs
